Battle Arena Toshinden Desperation at Any Health

Default: disabled. Enable on the launcher's Mods page.

This package lets players perform each character's normal desperation
move command at any health. Normal command input is still required; there is no
one-button shortcut.

The plugin patches only the stock low-health eligibility compare in the
desperation command matcher. It does not freeze or alter health, max HP,
damage, KO handling, or HUD gauges.

Disable the package and restart the game to restore stock low-health-only
behavior.
